out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Identifying Information
violations.observation: Observed that containers of poisonous and toxic materials or personal care items do not have legible manufacturer's labels. EHS observed two spray bottles containing cleaning products did not display a label.
violations.corrective_action: All containers of poisonous and toxic materials or personal care items shall bear a legible manufacturer's label to prevent accidental contamination of food and food contact surfaces. EHS instructed a manager to label the bottles. PIC labeled the bottles during inspection.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. EHS instructed PIC to clean out the mop heads,rinse them, and hang up the mops to air dry.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at kitchen handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC provided paper towels at kitchen handwashing sink.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. EHS instructed PIC to clean out the mop heads, rinse them, and hang up the mops to air dry.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed cooked corn at 109F that had been held for 1.5hr in the left section of the 6 DRW hot holding unit.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC reheated cooked corn to 165F and placed it in the hot holding unit with, adjusted temperature to maintain 135F or above.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: observed the left unit of the 6 DRW hot holding unit at 109F.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC adjusted the temperature of the left section of the 6 DWR hot holding unit to maintain 135F or above.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: Observed burnt out light bulb under the hood at the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Please replaced burnt out light bulb. PIC will email proof of the repaired bulb.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK NEXT TO THREE-VAT SINK MEET A MAXIUM TEMPERATURE OF 55F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC PLACED WORK ORDER FOR HANDWASHING SINK DURING INSPECTION; PIC UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SINK SHOULD BE REPAIRED SO THAT THE SINK CAN MEET 100F.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED Y SPLITTER INSTALLED AT MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC PURCHASED APPROPRIATE SPLITTER DURING INSPECTION. PIC WILL ENSURE THAT THE SPLITTER IS INSTALLED AS SOON AS IT IS RECEIVED.
